name: chat-send-unicode
description: Multi-byte UTF-8 text: emoji (4 bytes), CJK (3 bytes each), Arabic RTL (2 bytes each), and a combining acute accent. 22 code points, 35 UTF-8 bytes.
notes: The 4096 bound counts UTF-8 BYTES, not characters, code points, or UTF-16 units. An implementation that measures runes accepts frames it must reject — see invalid/text-oversized-multibyte.json. The combining mark also means byte length is not a function of rendered width; neither codec may normalize.
